principle_text: When the seller confirms the item is in excellent condition, avoid asking generic questions about the item's state to prevent stalling price negotiation progress.

When the seller offers assistance without discussing price, avoid providing vague confirmations of interest without negotiating or inquiring about the item's details.

When the seller clearly states their desired price, avoid making significantly lowball offers that are far below the seller's initial asking price, as it may signal desperation and weaken your negotiation position.
